## 2024-05-24 - [Canvas Reallocation Overhead in rAF]
**Learning:** Reassigning `canvas.width` or `canvas.height` unconditionally in a `requestAnimationFrame` loop—even to the same values but generated by floating-point calculations—causes implicit float-to-integer conversions that the browser detects as changes, triggering costly backing store reallocations and canvas context state resets.
**Action:** Always compute integer canvas dimensions (e.g., via `Math.floor()`) and perform a strict inequality check against the current `canvas.width`/`height` before assignment. Also, avoid defining simple helper functions (like `x => x !== null`) inside the tight loop.
